items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Among those were Don Byas, who later became famous all over America and Europe.

ctx.x: Lionel wouldn't, or couldn't, pay salaries that would enable us to take care of our families, and at the same time take care of our expenses on the road, so by July most of us quit. Most of us were replaced by younger and inexperienced musi-
cians. Among those were Don Byas, who later became famous all over America and Europe. At that time I was back in Los Angeles playing casuals, small jobs at Depression wages.
Depression wages you say? About what was that, Mr. Blakeney? What were the wages about that time?
